    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    separator = max((v for v in counts if v != background), key=lambda v: counts[v])

    seen = set()

        for c in range(w):

                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])

            freq = Counter()

                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                freq[grid[y][x]] += 1
